from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, shutil, json, hashlib
root=Path.cwd(); commit='86b816313e7a2dfc863013e19ae45a0b77d4eaa8'
paths=['apps/customer','apps/customer-service','packages','scripts/sites','package.json','pnpm-lock.yaml','pnpm-workspace.yaml','tsconfig.base.json','eslint.config.mjs','.gitignore']

    (dst/'DEPLOYMENT.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
    shutil.copytree(root/'apps'/app/'out',dst/'out',dirs_exist_ok=True)
    bundles=list((dst/'out').rglob('*.js'))
    assert any(meta['api_base'] in f.read_text() for f in bundles)
    print(app+': '+str(len(files))+' source files match commit; API URL verified in export')
